final_message:
The upload limit is fixed and all 4 tests pass.

The cause was `config/default.json`, which had `"maxMb": 5` while `docs/product.md` says 10 MB. The validator (`src/uploads/validate.js`) reads that value, so an 8 MB file was rejected. I changed it to `"maxMb": 10`. The request body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is derived from the same value, so it moves to 11 MB (10 MB plus the 1 MB multipart overhead) without a separate edit.

The existing test expecting a 12 MB PDF to be rejected with "max 10 MB" now passes too. I didn't commit the change.
